title: Prefers morning sessions
body: Mila is sharpest before midday — try to keep her bookings before 12:00 where possible. Avoid late-afternoon slots.

title: Series A prep — follow up
body: Working towards a Series A raise. Bring the positioning notes from the last strategy session and check in on the updated deck before the next call.

title: Quiet on email
body: Jonas tends to go quiet between sessions. A short reminder the day before usually gets a confirmation.
